title: Shiv Ganga
desc: A tale of love and lust, Shiv Ganga narrates how the god of love Kamdev met and subsequently lost his consort Rati, the goddess of passion.

title: Raiszaada
desc: When Sanjay, a policeman, arrests Jagannath, a gangster, his senior disagrees and frees the goon. Sanjay decides to resign and fight corruption on his own.
